title: Janyewar Kai Tsaye
intro: A cikin tarihin ni'imar Allah, akwai wata rai mai tsarki mara misaltuwa, wacce aka keɓe daga mutanensu don neman kaɗaici a cikin alkibla mai tsarki. Ba su san cewa wannan keɓewa zai haifar da wata alama ga dukkan duniyoyi ba, jarabawar bangaskiya da za a yi magana a kai har abada.
clues: Na sadaukar da kaina ga rayuwa ta hidima kafin haihuwata.
An sanya ni a ƙarƙashin kulawar wani annabi mai daraja.
An ciyar da ni da arzikin Allah wanda ya ba wa mai kula da ni mamaki.
Na janye daga iyalina zuwa wani wuri na gabas.
Mala'ika ya bayyana a gare ni a cikin siffar mutum cikakke, yana kawo mini labari game da ɗa tsarkakakke.
Da na dawo da jaririyata, mutanen gidana sun zarge ni, amma jaririn ya yi magana don kare ni.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا
verse: And mention, [O Muḥammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east. (19:16)
